stage: native bounded Pub/Sub mode on existing Client transport and request lifecycle
contracts: Idle ready Client adoption has Gate-protected checks before cold allocation and before release publication. Ordinary calls, sessions and observation cannot enter a dedicated subscriber.
One existing IO worker owns registry and response correlation. Controls pipeline under existing request/count/byte limits; messages and unrelated RESP3 pushes never consume control slots.

Distinct (family,binary-name) entries cover confirmed and reserved keys. Limits cover entries and aggregate names; fixed headers/buckets are also bounded. No descriptor-array copy or new runtime is added.

Named ACK order/kind/bytes and count domains are verified; duplicates and unknown-name unsubscribe do not imply a count change. Unsubscribe-all matches the unordered confirmed family or one absent-name ACK.
Future Value starts with xredisrequestresult and snapshots acknowledged count and confirmed domains at logical completion. Late cancellation/drain/close never modifies a completed result.

Actual byte acceptance distinguishes NOT_SENT from MAY_HAVE_EXECUTED. All terminal replies imply REPLIED even before the writer return tail. Sent cancellation preserves all remaining ACK and partial-write obligations under bounded drain grace.
Delivery uses existing owned push queue and actual reserved reply bytes. Count/byte overflow retires the connection. Queued replies, errors and results survive every physical owner.

Close frees at most WorkRequests registry entries per turn after all request duties retire. Cold mode/buckets remain until final Client release; a retained closed Client never dereferences a destroyed Engine in sync admission.
remaining: Subscription desired-state/reconnect/replay policy and an efficient receive notification/wait facade.
Other full-plan Sentinel/Cluster, RPC/MQTT/Cron completeness and native Windows/Linux production gates.

Message-only streaming, P95/P99.9, CPU/RSS, pinned upstream comparisons, fixed-arrival and continuous >=72h qualification. This stage measures a closed-loop ACK-plus-message component and existing ordinary calls.

known_development_failures.details: Initial unbraced conditional indentation failed -Werror in Client and fixture; fixed before runtime validation.

Initial unfrozen TLS cancellation fixture assumed one work turn had accepted bytes. Direct diagnostic run showed CANCELLED/NOT_SENT with zero ACKs. Ordinary modular TLS now tests complete small-write flow; single-TU owner-held checks observe positive partial bytes before cancellation and verify full original wire/ACK drain.

Development CLI initially combined mutually exclusive modular/single selectors; corrected. Windows footprint executable GC did not discard unresolved library functions; compiler constant assembly probes replaced that diagnostic linker approach. No functional gate was skipped.

private_layout_note: Compiler probes retain exact sizes and wire offsets for bare and Tracking TCP closures. Request allocation size stays104 bytes; Client grows8. Bare wire offset changes102 to103 because the optional tag occupies existing private padding. Tracking wire offset stays103. No public structure layout changes. Full TLS package sizes are separately measured.
